sources.snippet: What Zrald CLI Does Zrald CLI is a terminal-native AI coding agent focused on real engineering workflows: Complex bug fixing and refactoring Multi-step automation across real repositories Faster development with model routing, memory, and code intelligence The product is the CLI workflow itself. Users can bring their own model/provider keys (BYOK).
